'''Iskaayuma Starport''' was one of four [[Stellar-class starport]]s on the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Located in [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]], Rodia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]], the [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]] served as [[Grand Protector/Legends|Grand Protector]] [[Navik/Legends|Navik the Red's]] '''Home Fleet Headquarters''' for the [[Rodian Home Fleet]].

Landing on the Starport was discouraged unless someone had specific business on the city. As all Rodian cities with starports, Iskaayuma housed a standard [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] garrison.
